quarterly_data.signal: Customer Flen Health (Belgian biopharmaceutical company): AGC Biologics, the AGC Group's biopharmaceutical CDMO, entered an agreement to provide process development and GMP manufacturing services for the recombinant enzymes lactoperoxidase and glucose oxidase for Flen Health's next-generation diabetic foot ulcer therapy, at its Heidelberg site in Germany. The work supports Flen Health's planned U.S. IND application and Phase II trial; it extends a feasibility program begun in July 2025 to process development, scale-up and GMP manufacturing, with AGC Biologics planning to manufacture at the 100-liter and 1,000-liter scales.
